verdict.rationale: monday.com's developer docs describe subscribing to named platform events (create_item, change_column_value, user joined, board created) and receiving them in real time to keep your own backend in sync. They also mention connecting agents through a simple webhook. This is first-party event-subscription support for programmatic consumers. missing for 10: explicit documentation of webhook registration (endpoint URL setup), payload format, delivery guarantees/retries, and signature verification, plus any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Listen for real-time events and run your workflow the moment data changes.
